name: The People's Militia
objectiveText: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Highwaymen, 5 Defias Pathstalkers and 5 Defias Knuckledusters then return to him on Sentinel Hill.   Defias Highwayman slain  ( 15 )   Defias Pathstalker slain  ( 5 )   Defias Knuckleduster slain  ( 5 )

comments.body:
The location is SE of Moonbrook, back in a small valley in the hills.

Take along some hops, there's a questgiver there that will ask you to collect 5 hops.
From moonbrook go South East and you can find them on a path in the hills
replies: The hills are called the Dagger Hills I believe.

comments.body: The dagger hills is a perfect place for this quest. You almost get them one by one every time and theres a lot of everyone. Pretty quick respawn if you should need more. Cords are 52,71

The above are right.

Southwest..little ways behind moonbrook. There are a few camp sites with mixes of them.

If your low lvl, take a buddy with ya cause if you aggro too many at once, its a long mist ride back to your body.

Its all part of the chain quests that take FOREVER to do to get Dead Mines.

Take 5 hops (mech's in fields) with ya cause there is a drunk dwarf in a tent in the hills that you pass. This is if you want a barrel of brew. Good for stamina.

I had a few mates AOE the place so i had it easy.
replies: It is a great idea to take the 5 Hops with you, but do not use this brew for stamina, use it for [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=116]the quest from Lakeshire[/url], that you can pick up during the early stages of [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=65]The Defias Brotherhood[/url] quest chain, which sends you to Lakeshire.

ripped threw it as a lvl 21 dwarf hunter took 5 whole minutes. highest levels are 18 so would be easy for ide say 16lvl and up. otherwise bring a bud n get it done fast :)

I found them all at the mountains south of moonbrook, you can run up the mountains, just look for a path, and there will probably be a guy there, i was level 12 when i did this quest and i got owned, so dont try it like that unless your a lock or something. i got a 31 rogue to help me out so try to get someone to help you, its easy as anything if you do-NikkoAlexio(12 paladin Undermine)

There are a few mobs for this quest stationed around the farm house at 61,57.  They respawn pretty quickly, and the spawns seem to alternate randomly between level 17-18 Highwaymen and level 15-16 Knuckledusters.

If you head south/southeast from the vendors' carts by Sentinal Hill, get just over the top of those small hills & you should see them right in front of you.  The one between the silo & the farmhouse is an easy ranged-weapon pull from there.

Watch yourself when fighting the Defias mob southwest of (to the right of) the silo...move too far southeast & you risk aggroing the level 17-18 Greater Fleshripper that hangs out there, move too far southwest & you risk aggroing one of the level 17-18 Harvest Watchers in the field.  I managed to aggro both while fighting a level 18 Defias Highwayman (as a level 16 Human Rogue)...managed to sprint out of there seconds before dying.
replies:
Just wanted to update my post from yesterday: you can't reach the Defias mob that stands between the house & the silo from the hill...you have to walk to the base of the hill.  You'll still be too far away to aggro the mob, but close enough to pull with a crossbow.  That one will randomly either be a Highwayman or a Knuckleduster, either level 16 or 17.

b. Just be patient...to achieve your goals :)
